name: Neebota: Zeebo's Awakening
storyline:
Wet with sweat, Zeebo wakes up after what seems to have been the final dream in a long streak of torturous nightmares where his body painfully morphs. With his best friends at his bedside, he realizes his latest nightmare contained the main the clue to his suffering. And it's not just his parents' death! As he explains his insights to his friends, they all come to the same conclusion: it's time to take action.

With his friends Laurencia, Rashkadim, Bervie and his beloved pet Hekke, Zeebo embarks on a grand adventure to get to the bottom of what's causing disturbances not just in his sleep, but in his world Neebota. A quest that takes them through intrigue in their own backyard, the dark, deeply hidden underbelly of Neebota, as well as to our very own earth - but not quite as we know it.
summary: An open world party-based RPG set in an original fantasy world called Neebota, where Zeebo and his friends hunt for portals from our earth, and in doing so, uncover secret powers, ancient lore of their world and a vast conspiracy across space and time.
